Body.Content:
Stay up-to-date with what's happening in your other accounts and organizations with the 'Activity in Other Accounts and Orgs' panel. Preview and open chats, channels, and other activity in other accounts and orgs from your main Teams window, without switching tenants.

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/activity-in-other-accounts-orgs

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: November CY2026
